items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 6 at 1:29PM EST until November 7 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 4 to 5 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Fenwick Island DE to Chincoteague
VA out 20 NM and Coastal waters from Chincoteague to Parramore
Island VA out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 6 AM to 4 PM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
